summary.text: Samantha Poetter Parshall is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 6 who has represented the district since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes serving as communications director for former Kansas Secretary of State Kris Kobach.

paragraphs.text: Samantha Poetter Parshall's career experience includes working as communications director for former Kansas Secretary of State Kris Kobach.
She succeeded Jene Vickrey in the District 6 seat and took office on January 11, 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session Poetter Parshall was assigned to the Higher Education Budget Committee; in earlier sessions she served on the House Education, Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, House Local Government, Taxation, Corrections and Juvenile Justice, and House Federal and State Affairs committees.
She faces Democrat Frank Henderson in the general election.
